item.title: 5.1-Magnitude quake strikes Myanmar, tremors also felt in parts of Bangladesh
item.description: A 5.1-magnitude earthquake struck Myanmar on Wednesday night. The tremor also felt across parts of Bangladesh.Many residents reported feeling the shaking in various parts of the country, including the capital Dhaka.According to the EMSC website, the earthquake measured 5.1 on the Richter scale. item.title: Crimes against humanity: Life term convict acquitted

item.title: Over 100 detained in special crackdown at Mohammadpur, Adabor
